test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph below shows the number of students in various classes in a school. Study the graph below and answer the following question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517838f18a2bf054b6e5bbb63a1efadfb7c5ae90a50c8ca0f1f47dc57acc86d2.png] 

What is the ratio of the average number of students in classes 8, 9, 11, and 12 to the average number of students in classes 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 12?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of students in each class:

Class 6: 36

Class 7: 48

Class 8: 39

Class 9: 45

Class 10: 56

Class 11: 50

Class 12: 67

**Calculations:**

Average number of students in classes 8, 9, 11, and 12:

Sum = 39 + 45 + 50 + 67 = 201

Average = 201 / 4 = 50.25

Average number of students in classes 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, and 12:

Sum = 36 + 48 + 39 + 45 + 56 + 67 = 291

Average = 291 / 6 = 48.5

Ratio of the two averages:

Ratio = 50.25 / 48.5 = 5025 / 4850

Ratio = 201 / 194

**∴ The ratio is 201 : 194.**
